description:
In the North Forest lives Teddy, a great doll repairman. When humans throw broken dolls into the forest, Catsy, the guardian of the North Forest, collects them and brings them to Teddy. Then, the dolls are repaired beautifully by Teddy, and they either go on a journey to find new owners or choose eternal peace. And some come to life and become residents of the North Forest Full Bloom. One day, a shooting star falls on the always peaceful North Forest, and a box containing a small doll broken into pieces is found along with the remains of the shooting star. A doll that someone has broken so that it can never be repaired. Teddy carefully fixes the doll, and the doll opens its eyes with the name Orange Doll… 

(Source: Witch Comics, translated)
